decision: Owner, 2026-10-31: a separate crypto spot paper-account adapter reusing the tested cash accounting, with 24/7 timestamps, recorded spot quotes, explicit fees and simulated fill/exit rules; the frozen stock account and the existing crypto experiments unchanged; no real orders.
reuses: idxsig/paper_account.py orders_of / account_state / cost_basis (cash, reservations, cancels, fills, realized P&L), unmodified and still pinned by PAPER_ACCOUNT_v1
decisions: the crypto paper scan's frozen-policy decisions (paper/ledger.jsonl, PAPER-POLICY-v4) from signal 2026-10-30; only a decision the policy itself made a buy can become an order; PASS is recorded as a decline with the policy's reason
market_data: Binance spot best bid/ask from the public bookTicker endpoint, one CRYPTO_QUOTE record per observation, timestamped when observed; nothing fills or exits on an unrecorded price

fees.spread: paid by buying at the ask and selling at the bid

fill_rule: limit = policy decision quote x (1 + 0.01); fills at the ask of the first recorded quote from the decision quote on and before the order expires (1:00:00) whose ask <= limit; else EXPIRED_UNFILLED
exit_rule: stop set at the fill, 5% below it; exit at the bid of the first recorded quote after the fill whose bid <= stop (can be far below the stop: quotes are sparse), else at the bid of the first recorded quote at or after 5 days
marks: taken after each run's records are written, so they include that run's reservations
known_limits: sparse quotes: fills, stops and exits are only as fine as the observations
lot-size and minimum-notional rules not modelled; fractional quantities
top-of-book only: no depth, no queue position
all crypto paper decisions so far are PASS (the owner retired crypto entries); this account will mostly record declines until a policy buys
